title: Latent attention compression
summary: Inspect latent attention with latent width D/2 in one model configuration; its current cache layout is explicit and does not require a campaign to examine.

steps.explanation: Hidden states are compressed to a latent representation before attention projections, then returned to the model width.
observe: No dedicated MLA scalar diagnostic is emitted.

steps.explanation: The implemented cache retains expanded keys and latent values; inspect allocation shapes rather than assuming paper-equivalent compressed caching.
shapes: per layer FP32 cache storage: 4*(D+L) bytes/token

prerequisites: Prepare the selected tokenizer only for an initialized probe; prepare data before training.
try_changes: Predict L and every projected/cache shape before probing.
Change only latent_dim while preserving its required divisibility.
Try an illegal latent divisibility and observe configuration rejection.
limits: Current FP32 cache storage is 4*(D+L) bytes/token/layer, not 4*L and not a fused compressed-cache implementation.
This local implementation does not reproduce DeepSeek-V2 results or establish a compression-quality tradeoff.

papers.title: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
papers.claim_boundary: The paper motivates latent-attention questions; SparseLab's expanded-key cache and small reference implementation are not a reproduction.
